description: This is a PHP source file defining the Manufacturer class within the Opencart\
Catalog\\: This file contains a PHP class that interacts with the database to manage manufacturer entities in the Opencart catalog module. It provides methods to retrieve manufacturer details, lists of manufacturers, layout IDs, and includes caching mechanisms.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Represents the Manufacturer model in the OpenCart catalog system, providing methods to access manufacturer data, layout IDs, and managing database interactions.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a single manufacturer by ID, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination based on input parameters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific manufacturer.
